correction: PR #265 believed 'not done' after a completion failure meant the gate starts the first run again. Reality: with no config home the window's DoneAt was false too, but the gate in that environment exits 1 and starts nothing, so 'starts again at your next login' was false. DoneState now takes a 3-state GateState (GateRunsAgain, GateDone, GateUnknown) from GateStateAt and promises another run only for GateRunsAgain; GateUnknown is the zero value.
